notes.title: NUTS at Save & Sound!
notes.content:
Save & Sound is an online music festival with sales on Steam. Celebrate headbanging soundtracks as well as unique implementations of music and audio in games. NUTS will be 60% off during the festival but even better, tune in on Friday July 15th at 11am PDT to see a live foley performance from the sound designer of NUTS.

Working in her closet aka studio, Muuutsch will bring the sounds of Melmoth forest to live using old cans, coffee grounds, shot glasses and all sorts of weird bits and bobs. Don't miss it! 

Watch it live here:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/c/BedtimeDG]Youtube [/url]

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/bedtimedg]Twitch[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/SaveandSound?tab=1]Steam[/url]

There are so many amazing performances over the next few days so be sure to check out the schedule and watch as many as you can!

notes.title: NUTS is out!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Joon here, one of the developers.

I just wanted to make a quick update, to say thank you, and to list a few cool reviews that appeared, in case anybody wants to know why they should play NUTS :)

So first of all, if you're reading this and you bought the game, [b]thank you so much[/b]! I never thought this many people would enjoy our experimental squirrel adventure, but here we are! People are playing, and [i]finishing[/i] it, which means a lot to me and the rest of the team.

And here are some cool things:

🌟 Over 100 people have streamed NUTS on Twitch!
The game has a page that combines them all, [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/NUTS]right here.[/url] 
I do warn you, if you haven't played, or finished the game, there are a lot of spoilers in these streams so [b]be careful[/b]. You don't need anybody else to answer the question [i]"what are the squirrels up to"[/i] but yourself!

🌟 [url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/7k9q9x/nuts-game-review]Vice Games[/url] reviewed NUTS
[i]“Its visual puzzles remain modest where other games might have leaned into spiralling recursiveness; it asks questions rather than offering definitive answers. To cap it off, the game ends on a note of [b]genuine cosmic weirdness[/b], an opportunity for both I and the squirrels to finally escape the camera’s all-seeing eye.”[/i]

🌟 Danish music blog [url=https://soundvenue.com/gaming/2021/02/nuts-er-en-david-lynch-agtig-feberdroem-fyldt-med-egern-439517]Soundvenue[/url], called us a Lynchian fever-dream

🌟 Rock Paper Shotgun had a mixed response, but still said nice things!
“Without a hint of hyperbole, sound designer Almut Schwacke (who also did a solid turn as the voice of Nina) has produced some of the best foley work I’ve ever heard.”

🌟 “Like Firewatch for David Attenborough fans”
Gerald Lynch, TechRadar

🌟 “Dazzling artistic presentation”
Mike Towndrow, Six One Indie

🌟 “It’s a testament of what can be made when working remotely”
Simon Cardy, IGN

etc... etc... 

There's many more, and hopefully more to come. 
Now I'll go back to bugfixing for a while.

Stay tuned, and tell your friends about NUTS :)

- joon

notes.title: Features and Fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone, thank you so much for all the love and reviews so far. We are thrilled with the reception, and want to keep making the game better in response to community feedback.

This patch includes
[list]
[*][b][feature][/b] - Some streamers with Ultrawide monitors requested a way to play in windowed mode. It can be found in the settings menu. 
[*][b][feature][/b] - Added keyboard redundancies for AZERTY keyboards (Q/A and Z/W are the same), and an alternate way to use the handheld devices: you can use H to cycle handhelds if you can't use alphanumerics.
[*][b][bugfix][/b] - Dutch language had a few changes to soft-lock (e.g. Player can't hang up phone) in a few places., caused by the localization entries not having exact matches of line-count. I built a safety check and also combed over the localization file and pulled out all the offending entries. Shouldn't happen again!
[*][b][bugfix][/b] - The fax achievement was broken, and is now fixed! Sorry about this. 
[*][b][bugfix][/b] - Fixed bug that places camera out of bounds and makes you unable to pick it up again.
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: NUTS: Coming to Steam REAL SOON!
notes.content:
Hello there squirrel fans,

After a successful January launch on Apple Arcade, we’re delighted to be bringing NUTS to your eyeballs on February 4th 2021! We’ve come a long, long, LONG way since our demo version, and we’re so excited for you to get embroiled in the mysteries of Melmoth Forest. 

We think it’s a pretty neat game. But don’t take our word for it! Since we’ve been out on Apple Arcade for a week now, we’ve gathered a few press reviews. Here are some of the words that’ve been bringing tears to our little eyes:

“I finished Nuts a few days ago and I still want to go back”
Christian Donlon, [url=https://www.eurogamer.net/articles/2021-01-25-nuts-review-if-you-go-down-in-the-woods-today#comments]Eurogamer[/url]

“Without a hint of hyperbole, sound designer Almut Schwacke (who also did a solid turn as the voice of Nina) has produced some of the best foley work I’ve ever heard.”
Nate Crowley, [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/nuts-review]Rock Paper Shotgun[/url]

“NUTS feels like a great exemplar of the fact that developers don’t need to give players lots of things to do, when they can instead give you one thing that is incredible.”
Sean Martin, [url=https://www.pockettactics.com/nuts/review]Pocket Tactics[/url]

“Like Firewatch for David Attenborough fans”
Gerald Lynch, [url=https://www.techradar.com/news/apple-arcades-latest-game-nuts-is-like-firewatch-for-david-attenborough-fans]TechRadar[/url]

“Dazzling artistic presentation”
Mike Towndrow, [url=https://www.sixoneindie.com/read/nuts-review]Six One Indie
[/url]
“It’s a testament of what can be made when working remotely”
Simon Cardy, [url=https://www.ign.com/articles/nuts-review]IGN[/url]

Sounds good? Check out our trailer below… and see you in Melmoth Forest on the 4th!

notes.title: Nuts launch date trailer introduces a big mystery: Why do these squirrels have TNT?
notes.content: My dad spent a not-inconsiderable number of hours waging war against the local squirrel population over control of his bird feeders. He fought bravely, and resolutely, and ultimately he lost: After an incident involving an angry squirrel who got loose in the back of his truck, he decided the whole thing wasn't worth the hassle. Detente was achieved: The squirrels were permitted to go about their business more or less unmolested, and somehow life went on pretty much as it always had... Read more.

notes.title: The best free demos from the Steam Autumn Festival
notes.content:
Steam returns with actual hundreds of free demos for its Autumn Festival. I am but one woman, so I could never get through them all, but I have played what I would characterise as a lot over the past two days. My own personal labour of Hercules was undertaken so that I could bring you, the reader, a list of my favourite demos to provide, if not an exhaustive list, then at least a jumping off point.

I’ve got something for all of yez, gentle pals. Puzzle games? RPGs? Action? Strategy? Why yes, even that. I’ve got an EDM murder rave, dressing up in pre-revolutionary Paris, ripping up legal documents as a cute turnip, and rodents you should live in fear of. So many games! Your favourite is sure to be among them.

notes.title: Play the NUTS demo and wishlist us!
notes.content:
In this demo, you'll get to play a beta-version of the first level of the game.
Jump right into the action and the story of NUTS. It should take you about 30 to 45 minutes to complete.

NUTS is a mystery adventure about surveilling a community of wild and mischievous squirrels, deep in the woods.

NUTS grew from an experiment about watching and tracking squirrels using remote recordings. The game plays creatively with the player's gaze, splitting it between the character's eyes and various recording devices, and turns the simple act of looking into a series of careful framing decisions. To play NUTS is to care about perspective, sight-lines, timing and framing in a unique way.

The story tackles important contemporary themes - while the setting is natural and peaceful, it interrogates modern technological mediation and urban existence with topics including abuse of power, environmentalism and corruption.

The stylized graphics and minimal color palettes complement a realist audio treatment, using foley and voice acting.

The demo is part of the Steam Festival and the Guerrilla Collective showcase, which means it'll be available from June 13th until June 22nd. Enjoy!

---
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37976586/bf12fefad0e335251f7060436b8b51728c1ad137.jpg[/img]

[i]NUTS is made by a small, remote team of experienced indies. The code is made in Reykjavik, the trees are planted in Montreal, the books are written in Copenhagen and the foley is recorded in Berlin.[/i]
[list]
[*] Joon is an award winning game designer and has shipped multiple titles. His most recent solo-project Don’t Trip was Indie Game of the Month on Google Play and is regularly featured on the App Store. His games with Glitchnap were awarded multiple grants from the Danish Film Institute and Nordic Game program and were selected for multiple award shows and collections. He is also a summit advisor for GDC.
[*] Pol has received 3 IGF nominations, won the Developer’s Choice award at IndieCade, has been artist in residency at TAG in Montreal and has had his work shown in galleries.
[*] Char was awarded Best Game Writing from the Writer’s Guild of Ireland for her work on Divinity Original Sin 2 (PC Gamer’s #1 PC Game) and was working on Baldur’s Gate 3 for 2 years before joining the NUTS team.
[*] Almut has worked on big titles Anno 1800 (audio designer) and Dead island 2 (sound editor), as well as popular indie titles like Curious Expedition (sound design) and Through The Darkest of Times (composer).
[*] Torfi founded Tasty Rook, which released Out of the Loop and Triple Agent.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37976586/888fdfcaeba78c063e2a14786afc7dd7464eca6a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Nuts demo lets you spy on squirrels and their secrets
notes.content:
Squirrels: they’re hiding something. No matter how cute they look, they’re keeping something from us and maybe it’s more than just food. Perhaps you’ll see some of their secrets in the new demo for Nuts, a game about surveilling the goings-on of squirrels. By day, carefully place your cameras. By night, sit back to watch where the blighters go. It’s a first-person puzzle game of sorts, about the daily cycle of tweaking camera locations to follow the furry fiends, but also has a story about squirrely secrets. I’m interested.
